sources.title: MarsupialAI/Monstral-123B-v2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Monstral 123B v2 A Mistral-Large merge This model is a hybrid merge of Behemoth 1.2, Tess, and Magnum V4. The intention was to do a three-way slerp merge, which is technically not possible. To simulate the effeect of a menage-a-slerp, I slerped B1.2 with tess, then separately did B1.2 with magnum.
